title: WP-IMP-C: deterministic G06 planning controls in check_work_breakdown (badf-implementation-plan -> VALIDATED)
objective: Advance badf-implementation-plan IMPLEMENTED -> VALIDATED by adding the deterministic planning controls to check_work_breakdown -- the gate-enforced G06 DAG artifact -- and extending schemas/work-breakdown.schema.json with the optional per-task fields they read. Five controls, each failing-first + mutation-killed: IMP-C1 authority-not-reduced (required_roles superset of the authority matrix for the task's change_class); IMP-C2 acceptance coverage; IMP-C3 bounded execution budget (positive-integer max_attempts, a code control since the walker doesn't type-check, #171); IMP-C4 non-empty stop contract; IMP-C5 composition_after resolves + acyclic, separate from depends_on. Each fires only when its optional field is present, so the existing minimal work-breakdown and every record still validate. No new gate command, no lifecycle change.
business_value: The work-breakdown is the DAG the gate already validates; putting the operator's authority/coverage/budget/stop/composition controls there makes them deterministically enforced on every G06 dossier, not advisory. The type/positive-integer checks are code controls precisely because the schema walker doesn't type-check (#171) -- the exact gap WP-IMP-B flagged.
